##### Project general facts

ORLA Infinity is the latest masterpiece by OMNIYAT, a resort-style destination sculpted by the visionary architects Foster + Partners and managed exclusively by the global hospitality icon Dorchester Collection. With only a limited collection of duplex residences, it offers a wonderfully exclusive and personalised experience, each home thoughtfully positioned to blend indoor and outdoor living and to open onto breathtaking panoramic views. Every residence is a beachfront paradise reached by direct lift access, with double-height ceilings, beautifully framed floor-to-ceiling windows, a soft curved terrace and its own generous private pool.

Residents enjoy exclusive access to the full spectrum of The ORLA Collection's world-class amenities, beginning with a resident-only beach club, a magnificent infinity pool with sun loungers and luxurious cabanas, and a pristine private beach just steps from home. For wellbeing there is a spa with serene treatment rooms, an indoor temperature-controlled lap pool and a state-of-the-art cycling studio, while entertainment comes in the form of two private cinemas, refined cigar lounges, a bowling alley, indoor kids areas and welcoming lounges throughout, all set within a captivating landscaped ecosystem by ZED Collective. Service is equally elevated, with round-the-clock residence concierge and security, doorman and porter, valet parking, and à la carte housekeeping, laundry, bespoke in-residence catering, floristry and five-star experiences at home.

The interiors are the work of the award-winning studio YODEZEEN, whose celebrated craftsmanship combines colours, textures and the finest materials into an inviting environment for stylish living. Kitchens are dressed in walnut wood panels with a glossy lacquer finish and equipped with high-quality European appliances, while the master bathroom is envisioned in warm pinkish marble with a delicate pattern and innovative dual doorless passageways. Walk-in closets, ensuite bathrooms and elegant sanctuaries behind sliding glass doors complete each home, all complemented by smart home automation and discreetly hidden service entrances that preserve absolute privacy.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is a luxurious community located on an artificial island that is shaped like a palm tree, with a trunk, fronds, and a crescent-shaped breakwater that surrounds the island. The Palm Monorail and the trunk road connect the island with Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance.

The community is home to a variety of high-end residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, as well as some of the most luxurious hotels and resorts in Dubai. The community is known for its stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, its pristine beaches, and its world-class amenities. Its global profile and limited supply of beachfront homes attract high-net-worth buyers and support premium rental rates and long-term capital value for owners.

In addition to residential properties and hotels, Palm Jumeirah is home to a range of retail and dining options, including the iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort, which features an array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues. The island also boasts a range of recreational activities, including water sports, beach clubs, and golf courses.
